contract_plain_english: On a rectangular or logically rectangular finite-volume grid, the source presents dimensional splitting as the simplest way to extend a one-dimensional high-resolution method: take fractional steps that solve one-dimensional problems along each coordinate direction in turn. This is a qualitative algorithm description, not a fixed ordering or accuracy theorem, and the source notes that some cases need a more fully multidimensional method.
